name: Fahad Dubush
intro: AI Engineer. I explore how AI and automation can turn unconventional ideas into practical solutions that save time, reduce costs, and make technology work smarter.
outro: That’s the tour. Let’s build something that thinks.
about: I’m drawn to ideas that sit outside the usual playbook: things that haven’t been tried yet, or opportunities others might overlook. I enjoy exploring how AI and automation can solve problems in ways that save time and money. Before starting a project, I like to research the options and find the best balance between capability and cost. My curiosity extends beyond technology to games, films, shows, and books, anywhere a new idea or perspective can spark something worth building.

projects.t: AI guidance for Hajj and Umrah
projects.d: A local-first question-answering application that retrieves multilingual sources and grounds responses in cited context.
r: Combines semantic and keyword retrieval for English and Arabic questions.
Supports local Ollama models and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
Includes source citations, streaming responses, and out-of-domain handling.
Uses conversation-safe caching for standalone questions to avoid reusing cached results for follow-up questions.

projects.t: A retrieval evaluation toolkit for legal research
projects.d: An evaluation harness for comparing retrieval approaches and detecting regressions in a legal research dataset.
r: Compares lexical, dense, hybrid, and reranked retrieval approaches.
Reports retrieval metrics and results by practice area.
Includes a CI gate designed to flag retrieval regressions.

projects.t: A terminal dashboard for a self-hosted server
projects.d: An SSH-friendly Linux terminal interface for monitoring host telemetry, Docker containers, and maintenance tasks.

Includes a demo mode with fictional data and disabled actions.
Supports configurable settings, keyboard navigation, and optional animation.
